task_context.reference_solution: Reading the dark bars on the chart, we find that the high temperatures for the five days are 49, 62, 58, 57, and 46 degrees.  Their average is $(49+62+58+57+46)/5=\boxed{54.4}$ degrees Fahrenheit.
